title: Ordinary completed integral scalar extension preserves uniform finite Tor constructibility
statement: Fix a prime l, an integer p different from l, finite extensions E and F of Q_l, an algebra inclusion i:E -> F, and any scheme X. If M in the derived category of completed integral E-coefficient sheaves is integrally constructible and its finite reductions have one uniform finite Tor interval, then ordinary derived scalar extension of M along the actual completed coefficient inclusion is integrally constructible over F and has the same uniform finite Tor interval. No finite-type, geometric-base, ramification-index or compactification hypothesis is required. The finite exponents are the existing n+1 convention.

source.place: Sections 6.5--6.6; finite-free completed scalar comparison, together with Stacks Tag 06YY for derived scalar transitivity and finite scalar Tor preservation.

proof.text: Use intrinsic-to-legacy completeness for an auxiliary finite-field datum of prime characteristic greater than l. This gives unrestricted derived completeness of the input without geometric assumptions on X.

The finite-free completed scalar comparison is invertible on this complete input. Transport the intrinsic scalar-constructibility theorem along that comparison to obtain constructibility for ordinary derived extension along the actual completed coefficient map.

For every n use completedScalarReductionComparison at the same exponent n+1 on E and F. The existing finite scalar-extension Tor theorem preserves the input interval [a,b]. In its test-object factorization compose the presenting isomorphism with the reduction/scalar comparison. This transports the Tor-amplitude predicate to the actual reduced output with precisely the original bounds at every n. Combine with constructibility.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteTorIntegralCompletedScalarExtension
    (p l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra ℚ_[l] F] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] F]
    (i : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] F) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (hM : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X M) :
    finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l F X
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M)
